description: Use this when the user asks which drugs or therapies are in development against a target, mechanism, hallmark of aging or age-related disease, who develops them and how far each has got. Drug and therapy programs, furthest stage first, with developers, partners, code names, modality, targets, mechanism, indications with stages and lifespan evidence. Read one with get_asset; count them with count_pipeline. A plan that includes drug and therapy programs reads every record in full; others read an outline, as on the site.

cursor.description: From the last page's `pagination.next_cursor`; keep the other arguments the same.

hallmark.description: A hallmark of aging the asset acts on.

indication.description: A disease, by name or entity key (`idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis`, `alzheimer-disease`).

mechanism.description: Words that must all appear in the asset's mechanism line (case-insensitive).

organisation.description: An organization key: the assets it develops, partners on or licensed out.

q.description: Letters and digits in any of the asset's names or code names (`UBX1325` matches UBX-1325).

stage.description: Stage: with `indication`, the stage for that indication; otherwise the asset's furthest stage.

target.description: A target: a gene symbol or key (`GLP1R`, `bcl2l1`) or a process key (`mtor`, `cellular-senescence`).

name: list_assets
